name: Ogawa (Nagano, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogawa village emblem in orange: a stylised device of curved strokes like the character 小.
history: Municipal flag of Ogawa, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ogawa village emblem — a stylised device of curved strokes like the character 小
